messages.author: 87cf4991b6a810ee
messages.subject: Persistent data?
parts: How do I store data in server.R so that it is available to multiple outputs? The hieightweight example uses a global var to store the csv data but I am using the fileInput widget to load data. I can't seem to make this data available to other outputs.

messages.author: f806781d102fe0ab
messages.subject: Re: Persistent data?
parts:
Just define a reactive function that loads data from your file input:

myData <- reactive(function() {
  read.csv(input$file[1]$datapath)
})

Then from inside your outputs, call myData() to retrieve the data. Don't worry about read.csv being called multiple times; the function behind myData will only execute when input$file changes, no matter how many times myData is referred to.

messages.subject: Re: Persistent data?
parts:

shinyServer(function(input, output) {
    persistentData <- c()
})

messages.subject: Re: Persistent data?
parts:
OK. I think it's unlikely you'll ever want to do an assign like that from inside the server function, unless it's something like

sessions <<- c(sessions, new_session)

or whatever. If it's just a normal assign, the variable will be overwritten every time a new client connects.
